packageRules.description: The image publishes each qBittorrent release in two libtorrent flavors (5.2.3-1 for 1.2.x, 5.2.3-lt2-1 for 2.0.x) plus a trailing image-revision number that occasionally increments on its own (base image rebuilds). This versioning keeps Renovate within the lt2 family and lets it offer those revision-only rebuilds too, which plain docker versioning would skip.
